basics.name: Chirag Batra
basics.title: B.Tech CS (Data Science) · Class of 2027
basics.summary: Computer Science (Data Science) undergraduate (batch of 2027) who builds ML systems end to end in Python: data pipelines, model training, explainability, and REST API deployment. Two internships, a live-deployed ML web app, and Hireloop, an LLM job copilot with retrieval, agents, and evals, in progress. Seeking an AI Engineer role.

highlights: Built EventLens AI, a full-stack financial risk analytics platform in Python, computing Value-at-Risk and Monte Carlo projections for portfolio exposure.
Trained a Random Forest model using a Scikit-learn pipeline on 250+ event-days of GDELT news data to predict abnormal returns from news sentiment and volatility features.
Developed ETL pipelines aggregating news event data with live market pricing into a SQLAlchemy database, delivered through FastAPI REST services and a React reporting dashboard.
Developed Python preprocessing pipelines to clean drift and noise from four sensor telemetry streams, including GPS, IMU, barometric pressure, and temperature data.
Implemented automated quality control checks that detected altitude-control anomalies in time-series sensor data.
Conducted comparative analysis across five operational scenarios, quantifying performance trade-offs for technical stakeholders.

projects.name: Bharat Market Pro: Equity Research & ULIP Monitor (7th-semester team project)
projects.description: An Indian-equity research terminal and ULIP fund monitor that unifies NSE prices, company fundamentals, filings, news, and insurer fact-sheets. It uses deterministic extraction and validation for insurer PDFs and measures guidance signals against 5-, 20-, and 60-session forward returns relative to NIFTY.

projects.name: Hireloop: AI Job Copilot (Ongoing)
projects.description: Building a full-stack AI job copilot that parses a resume into a structured profile, ranks jobs from public ATS APIs, and tailors each resume using only facts from the user's profile. The system combines hybrid retrieval, a LangGraph workflow with human approval, validated LLM outputs, and a faithfulness verifier that flags unsupported claims.

projects.name: Customer Churn Prediction and Retention Uplift Modeling
projects.description: Built a churn model on 7,032 Telco customers using XGBoost and SMOTE, reaching 0.82 AUC-ROC. T-learner uplift modeling identifies persuadable customers and cuts simulated retention campaign spend by 56%. Includes SHAP explanations, a FastAPI prediction API, and MLflow experiment tracking.

projects.name: Proactive Academic Intervention System
projects.description: Team-built full-stack ML application that scores 5,000 student records with a hybrid risk model (70% ML, 30% rules), reaching 0.887 ROC-AUC, 0.764 F1, and 79.9% recall on at-risk students. Deployed on Render with six data-structure and algorithm modules.
